paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante apawt nung uh kum zali-le-sawmgiatna kum, Israelte tung a Solomon lal akum lina, Ziv kha, akha nihna in TOUPA' inn lam apan uhi.
heading: Solomon In Tempul Alam
english: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month Ziv, which is the second month, he began to build Yahweh’s house.

paite: Solomon in TOUPA a dia a-inn lam adunglam tong sawmguk ahi a, availam tong sawmnih ahi, asanlam tong sawmthum ahi.
english: The house which King Solomon built for Yahweh had a length of sixty cubits, and its width twenty, and its height thirty cubits.

paite: Huai inn a Mun Siangthou malam a inlim availam tan tong sawmnih a sau ahi a, amalam a pen availam tong sawm ahi.
english: The porch in front of the temple of the house had a length of twenty cubits, which was along the width of the house. Ten cubits was its width in front of the house.

paite: Inn a ding in tohlet neuchik vathangkalh om in abawl hi.
english: He made windows of fixed lattice work for the house.

paite: Huai inn baang kimvel leh tempul baang kimvel in tempul mun baang kimvel leng huai inn baang si in inn chial nei alam hi.
english: Against the wall of the house, he built floors all around, against the walls of the house all around, both of the temple and of the inner sanctuary; and he made side rooms all around.

paite: Akimvel in dantan abawl a; achial nuainungpen availam tong nga ahi a, alai a pen availam tong guk ahi. Athumna availam tong sagih ahi. Kalvaite ahihleh inn baang a kigolh akiphamoh kei; inn polam ah akimvel in baang ah akingakna akibawl ziak ahi.
english: The lowest floor was five cubits wide, and the middle was six cubits wide, and the third was seven cubits wide; for on the outside he made offsets in the wall of the house all around, that the beams should not be inserted into the walls of the house.

paite: Huai inn alam lai un suang alaihna mun a seksa vek a bawl ahi. Huchi in alam sung un sek ging, heipi ging leh sik vanzat ging huai inn ah zak ahi kei hi.
english: The house, when it was under construction, was built of stone prepared at the quarry; and no hammer or ax or any tool of iron was heard in the house while it was under construction.

paite: Dantan laita pente kongpi huai inn taklam pang ah a-om a; alaita ah kahna kivial in akahtou ua, alaita a pan athumna tan ah.
english: The door for the middle side rooms was in the right side of the house. They went up by winding stairs into the middle floor, and out of the middle into the third.

paite: Huchi in huai inn ahon lam a, azou a, inn bel sidar inkam leh apek in akhuh hi.
english: So he built the house and finished it; and he covered the house with beams and planks of cedar.

paite: Inchial neite akisituah vek in tong nga chiat a sang in alam a; huaite sidar sing sige toh apeh hi.
english: He built the floors all along the house, each five cubits high; and they rested on the house with timbers of cedar.

paite: Solomon kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: Yahweh’s word came to Solomon, saying,

paite: "Hiai inn na lam laitak tungtang thu, ka dan thusehte na pom a, ka vaihawmte na zuih a, ka thupiak tengteng zui dia na pom peuhmahleh, na pa David kiang a ka gensa, huai ka thu na tung ah ka hihkip ding.
english: “Concerning this house which you are building, if you will walk in my statutes, and execute my ordinances, and keep all my commandments to walk in them, then I will establish my word with you, which I spoke to David your father.

paite: Israel suante lak ah ka teng dia, ka mi Israelte ka limsak lou kei ding," achi hi.
english: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.”

paite: Huchi in Solomon in huai inn alam a, azouta hi.
english: So Solomon built the house and finished it.

paite: Inn sunglam baang ding in sidar singpek azang a; apialkhang a pan atunglam baang pha in asunglam ah sing abelh vek hi. Apialkhang ding in meilah singpek aphahbeh hi.
heading: Tempul Sunglam Vante Bawlna / (2 Kro 3.8-14)
english: He built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar; from the floor of the house to the walls of the ceiling, he covered them on the inside with wood. He covered the floor of the house with cypress boards.

paite: Inn phaitam lam tong sawmnih pen pialkhang a pan baangte tan in sidar singpek vek in abawl a; biakna mun, Mun Siangthoupen a ding in leng asunglam ah azang hi.
english: He built twenty cubits of the back part of the house with boards of cedar from the floor to the ceiling. He built this within, for an inner sanctuary, even for the most holy place.

paite: Huai inn, abiakna munpi adunglam tong sawmli ahi.
english: In front of the temple sanctuary was forty cubits long.

paite: Huai insung lam ah apakmum leh apakpalh limgelh kilawm sidar sing a khuak a-om a; avek in sidar sing vek ahi a; suang himhim muh ahi kei hi.
english: There was cedar on the house within, carved with buds and open flowers. All was cedar. No stone was visible.

paite: TOUPA thukhun bawm koihna ding in huai insung ah biakna lam ah mun abawl hi.
english: He prepared an inner sanctuary in the middle of the house within, to set the ark of Yahweh’s covenant there.

paite: Huai, biakna mun sung adunglam tong sawmnih, availam tong sawmnih, asanlam tong sawmnih ahi a, dangka-eng hul ngen in aluan a; sidar sing a bawl maitam leng aluan hi.
english: Within the inner sanctuary was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in width, and twenty cubits in its height. He overlaid it with pure gold. He covered the altar with cedar.

paite: Huchi in Solomon in huai insung dangka-eng hul ngen in aluan a; biakna mun malam dangka-eng khainiang in adaikaih a; huai dangka-eng in aluan hi,
english: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold. He drew chains of gold across before the inner sanctuary, and he overlaid it with gold.

paite: Huai in avek a azoh pha in apumpi in dangka-eng in aluan tawmtawm hi. Biakna mun maitam pumpi leng dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: He overlaid the whole house with gold, until all the house was finished. He also overlaid the whole altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary with gold.

paite: Biakna mun ah tong sawm tuaktuak a sang, cherub nih olive sing in abawl hi.
english: In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olive wood, each ten cubits high.

paite: Cherub kha khat pen tong nga ahi a, cherub kha langkhat pen tong nga mah ahi. Akha mong khat a pan akha langkhat mong kikal tong sawm ahi.
english: Five cubits was the length of one wing of the cherub, and five cubits was the length of the other wing of the cherub. From the tip of one wing to the tip of the other was ten cubits.

paite: Cherub khat pen leng tong sawm ahi a; cherubte akikim geih un, akibang geih uhi.
english: The other cherub was ten cubits. Both the cherubim were of one measure and one form.

paite: Cherub khat sanlam tong sawm ahi a, cherub khat pen leng huai toh kikim mah ahi.
english: One cherub was ten cubits high, and so was the other cherub.

paite: Cherubte insung gilzaw ah akoih a; cherubte kha akizak a, khat kha in baang langkhat lam ava khoih a, cherub khat pen kha in leng baang langkhat akhoih a; huai inn laitak ah akha uleh akha uh akisukhatuah uhi.
english: He set the cherubim within the inner house. The wings of the cherubim were stretched out, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the middle of the house.

paite: Huai cherubte dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.

paite: Inn baang tengteng akimvel in cherubte, tum sing leh pakpalh limte gelh kilawm insung lam leh polam ah abawl hi.
english: He carved all the walls of the house around with carved figures of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, inside and outside.

paite: A-inn pialkhang sunglam leh polam dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: He overlaid the floor of the house with gold, inside and outside.

paite: Biakna mun lutna ding in olive sing kongkhak abawl a; kongpi lutung leh kongpi biangte abaang seh nga suah seh khat chiat ahi.
english: For the entrance of the inner sanctuary, he made doors of olive wood. The lintel and door posts were a fifth part of the wall.

paite: Huchi in olive sing inn kongkhak nih abawl a; huai ah cherubte tum sing leh pakpalh limte gelh kilawm in abawl hi. Huai dangka-eng in aluan a; cherubte leh tum singte dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: So he made two doors of olive wood; and he carved on them carvings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold. He spread the gold on the cherubim and on the palm trees.

paite: Tempul lutna ding in abaang seh li suah seh khat chia in olive kongpi khuam abawl lai hi.
english: He also made the entrance of the temple door posts of olive wood, out of a fourth part of the wall,

paite: Meilah sing kongkhak nih toh; kongkhak khat a pek nihte kheptheih ahi a, kongkhak khat pen apek nih leng kheptheih ahi.
english: and two doors of cypress wood. The two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.

paite: Huaite ah cherubte tum sing leh pakpalh limte agelh a; huai gelh kilawm mamtak in dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: He carved cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold fitted on the engraved work.

paite: Tempul huangsung intual sunggilzaw pen suangsek chial thum leh sidar singpek thuah khat in abawl hi.
english: He built the inner court with three courses of cut stone and a course of cedar beams.

paite: Akum lina, Ziv kha in TOUPA inn suangphum lep khit ahi.
english: The foundation of Yahweh’s house was laid in the fourth year, in the month Ziv.

paite: Akum sawm-le-khatna, Bul kha, akha giatna in huai inn zuih ding bangbang, bangkim mansa vek ahi. Huchi in kum sagih sung alam hi.
english: In the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, the house was finished throughout all its parts and according to all its specifications. So he spent seven years building it.
